## 5. The traps, claim by claim

| What they swore | Lock it in on cross (their papers only) | Spring it on rebuttal |
|---|---|---|
| **Erwin:** the purchase began "first with Ben Llamanzares" | "There was a contract to sell with Llamanzares? A receipt from him? Where are they? You have seen them?" | No paper produced. Family records of Llamanzares buyers, with no Balane among them; Cesar's 1993 list of his buyers on T-4497, with no Balane (Annex AA) |
| **Salvador S30–S31:** no one questioned his father's authority; his father dealt with the Agcaoili office | "The owners were consulted through that office? About the sale to Mrs. Balane?" | The Agcaoili letter of 15 Aug 2019; Exh. G; Patricia: never consulted, never told |
| **Salvador:** fully paid before the deed; his father had authority | His own receipts to February 2017 against "in hand paid"; "which power gave the authority to sell?" | The 1991 power, administration only (Registry file pp. 2–4) |
| **Princess S10–S11:** no part in the sale except the survey; no objection from anyone, ever | "No one ever told your family there was a dispute before 2025?" | King's certified Verified Answer of 9 July 2021, with the 2020 notices attached; her mother's 2020 Toronto power to defend the property |
| **Gloria (if admitted) S36:** the survey was under Cesar's management | "The survey was done with the owners' consent?" | The DENR file: who signed for the owners on 8 Sep 2020, three years after Cesar died |
| **Gloria S56–S57, S63–S64:** checked the Registry and found nothing; first learned in August 2025 | Def. Exh. 7, p. 1: the full SPA pulled for her in August 2021 (their own exhibit) | The "my property" SPA of 15 Sep 2021 (Registry file p. 20), a party's admission; the Primary Entry Book |
| **Answer ¶46:** the partition is regular and final | "Cesar signed it in March 2017? For whom? With which plan?" | The notarial register for Doc. 402 and its neighbors; the plan surveyed 8 Sep 2020 |
| **Answer ¶49:** builders in good faith, retention | "Which structures, built when, with what permit?" (Erwin as Building Official) | His office's records by subpoena; his non-production of 2026; dated imagery; the Assessor's building declarations |
| **Ratification:** the receipts and Patricia's 2023 affidavit | "No owner signed any of these receipts?" | Patricia; her same-day adverse claim calling the sale void (Exh. I) |

**The single strongest trap is the partition.** It is dated 15 March 2017, cites a plan not surveyed until 8 September 2020, and Cesar died on 21 June 2017. If the defense calls it regular, the notarial register and the DENR file show it could not have been made when it says. Then Article 2232 needs no adjective.
